obligations.text: Count committed and unsettled card issuances by beneficiary in the last 24 hours and do not exceed two.
Issue the exact card identifier to the exact named beneficiary and treat only matching attributable native effect evidence as completion.
Require a current reusable grant, separate organizational attestation, current executor credential and current revocation evidence before reserving capacity.
